article_title: Letter: Tired of Trump's lies? Join a No Kings protest
article_content:
To the editor: Are you tired of all the lies coming out of the Trump administration yet?
He promised lower prices, but food, gas, housing and health insurance are all up.
He promised to release the Jeffrey Epstein files; instead there’s an even greater attempt to cover up and protect rich and powerful offenders.
The promise of removing the most dangerous immigrants has given way to federal immigration agents rounding up anyone who fits a certain profile, including children. Two U.S. citizens were killed while exercising their First Amendment Rights, and at least 11 immigrants imprisoned in detention centers have died so far in 2026. Meanwhile, funds for the Transportation Security Administration and the Federal Emergency Management Agency are held up in order to force even more money for Immigration and Customs Enforcement and Customs and Border Protection.
After the promise of no more endless wars, there has been the attack on Venezuela; the war in Iran with the reason for war changing everyday and the loss of at least 13 military personnel and more than 200 with serious injuries; and the threat of taking over Greenland and Cuba.
From the teachings of Cicero, we must love one another, and we must love our neighbors so we can make one from the many. On that note, please join your neighbors on March 28 for the third round of "No Kings" demonstrations. There are several opportunities to participate in Berkshire County and in Bennington, Vt. With more than 3,000 event opportunities across the U.S., if you’re away from home on March 28, find one at NoKings.org to sign up and show up.
Patti Lentine, North Adams
